messages:
Casey (PM): quick sync on the autoscale panel — got feedback from support: new teams are confused by the pool dropdown when they have no Dedicated pools. Also some requests to simplify SLO controls on mobile.
Rina (Design): I mocked an empty-state card instead of an empty dropdown. shows: icon, title 'No pools yet', body 'Use Hosted for instant scale or create a Dedicated pool for reserved throughput', primary CTA 'Use Hosted', secondary 'Create Dedicated'. Thoughts?
Leo (Eng): love the CTAs. Implementation note: if user picks Use Hosted we should prefill the form and skip the extra modal. Creating Dedicated should open the pool creation wizard.
Tanya (SRE): also think we should add a tiny banner if an org has billing blocked that suggests contacting billing before creating Dedicated — saves failed creations.
Noor (A11y): accessibility points: 1) the empty-state CTAs must be real buttons (not links) with focus styles; 2) when the empty state appears we should set aria-live polite to announce it to screen readers, otherwise keyboard users may miss the change.
Rina (Design): good call. I'll make the buttons look distinct and add a visually-hidden status message for screen readers: 'No pools configured. Choose Hosted or create a Dedicated pool.'
Casey (PM): mobile SLO: users say the slider is fiddly on phones. Rina, can we show presets on small screens and full slider on desktop? Presets: Save / Balanced / Performance.
Rina (Design): yes — presets will map to internal SLO values: Save=30, Balanced=60, Performance=85. I'll add microcopy under each: Save='Lower cost', Balanced='Balanced latency/cost', Performance='Lowest latency'.
Leo (Eng): backend needs to accept preset keys (save, balanced, performance) and map to p95 targets. Also we should emit telemetry when users change from preset to custom slider so we know usage.
Tanya (SRE): edge-case: when a customer sets burst to 0 while having queued jobs, what happens? UI should warn: 'Burst disabled — queued requests may be delayed.' Show an inline toast.
Rina (Design): propose renaming burst to 'Burst (temporary capacity)' and show a duration dropdown (15m / 1h / 6h). default 15m. The small note: 'Billed separately during burst window.'
Noor (A11y): ensure the duration dropdown is accessible: native select or a role=listbox with aria-activedescendant. Also tooltip content must be reachable via keyboard (enter to open, escape to close).
Casey (PM): copy for empty dropdown hover state: 'No pools available. Use Hosted or create a Dedicated pool.' Also add a small inline link 'What's the difference?' that opens docs.
Leo (Eng): will add api endpoints: POST /ui/action/create-dedicated-start and GET /ui/estimate?slo=... to power cost snippets. We should debounce calls from slider.
Rina (Design): final ask — can we show a tiny projected QPS tag next to slider/presets: e.g., 'Est. peak QPS: 120'. That makes the tradeoffs clearer.
Noor (A11y): make sure the QPS tag has text alternative and is not icon-only. Also any 'recommended' badges must meet contrast 3:1 at least (ideally 4.5:1).
ops-bot: preview deployed to staging: https://staging.redwood.ai/console/autoscale?preview=empty-state-ux
Casey (PM): will test staging later today and collect support snippets. tagging @Rina for updated frames. Thanks everyone! :rocket:
